Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Absolutely — I’d be happy to help you get started!
If you're new to Happy Wax, the basics are pretty simple:
How to start using a wax warmer
Open your warmer and read the included instructions for safety and setup.
If your warmer uses a light bulb, remove any plastic wrapping from the bulb before use.
Wipe down the top of the warmer or place the silicone dish/liner on top if your warmer includes one.
Add your wax melts:
For wax cubes, use no more than 1 melt at a time.
For Happy Wax bears or smaller melts, use about 2–3 bears depending on how strong you want the scent.
Do not add water or oil to the wax.
Turn on the warmer and enjoy the fragrance.
Good to know
Some of our warmers melt wax with a light bulb.
Others use a built-in ceramic heater.
Many of our warmers include a silicone “no-scrape” wax removal dish, which makes changing scents much easier.
